title: Time-changed reflected diffusions: subdiffusion, superdiffusion and explosion
summary: Motivated by semi-Markov models of anomalous diffusion, we study obliquely reflected diffusions in generalized parabolic domains under independent inverse-subordinator time changes. We focus on infinite-mean subordinators, whose inverse clocks can slow the superdiffusive growth induced by reflection. For domains with cross-sectional radius asymptotic to $a_\infty x^β$, where $-1<β<1$, we strengthen the almost-sure growth laws of [MMW23] to obtain precise second-moment asymptotics when the subordinator's Laplace exponent is regularly varying at zero, and matching bounds more generally.…
